title: No, No, Dog!
level_description: Pre-reader: 1-2 words per page, picture support, repetitive pattern

character.name: Dog
character.description: Cute fluffy brown dog with floppy ears, big round eyes, pink tongue often out, short wagging tail

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover. Ask: Uh oh, what did Dog do? What do you think this book is about?
parent_tips.during_reading: Use a fun voice for 'No, no!' - make it playful, not angry. Pause to let your child look at each mess Dog made. Ask: What did Dog do this time?
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: Why did Dog make messes? (Dogs get excited!) Did the child still love Dog at the end? Talk about pets and forgiveness.

comprehension_questions.question: What did Dog do on the couch?
comprehension_questions.answer: Jumped on it / Made cushions fly

comprehension_questions.question: How did the child feel at the end?
Do you think Dog was being naughty on purpose?
comprehension_questions.answer: No, dogs just like to play and explore
